snippet.title: Jeff The Killer: Horror Game (Teaser)
snippet.description:
A teaser of the popular horror game by Jeff the Killer.

Your goal is to get out of the terrible house. You have 6 days. Don't make any noise and be careful. Jeff can hear very well. Good luck!

#jeffthekiller #horrorgame #creepypasta #scary #indiegame
